manuscript_title: Milne's rationality conjecture for abelian varieties

problem_family_title: Polynomial-time scheduling on three identical machines.
manuscript_title: A Polynomial-Time Algorithm for Three-Machine Unit-Job Scheduling
statement_summary: We give a uniform deterministic polynomial-time algorithm for scheduling unit-length jobs with arbitrary precedence constraints on three identical parallel machines. The algorithm constructs a schedule of minimum makespan and decides exactly whether all jobs can finish by a specified deadline. Global boundary conditions and simplification of inherited information keep the descriptions bounded throughout the decomposition.

manuscript_title: Filtered products and boundary-preserving compression in complex cobordism
statement_summary: We prove that, in sufficiently large smash powers, an $MU$-null restriction to a finite pointed subcomplex becomes stably null on the entire union of products with a fixed positive proportion of restricted factors. An example at equality shows that the strict rank inequality cannot be removed.
